Software Foundation — release and recovery order

1. Freeze source, version, target/backend inventory and qualification policy.
2. Verify supplier terms, pinned inputs and notices. Resolve GUI terms before
   distributing optional GUI code. Select exact immutable prepared recipes.
3. Fetch verified compiled C++ and matched Rust SDK/dependency groups from the durable base. Rust
   is the default; core_provider=cpp is an explicit legacy choice. Missing
   groups fail with explicit maintenance instructions; never cold-build implicitly.
4. Build each configuration once. Stage only allowed target runtime dependencies;
   inspect every binary for architecture, generic CPU floor and runtime ceiling.
5. Inventory and relocate each actual final archive:
   python3 tools/artifact.py create ARCHIVE --manifest MANIFEST.json
   python3 tools/artifact.py verify ARCHIVE --manifest MANIFEST.json
6. Assemble a complete local release, copying the exact SDK compiled/source/checksum
   groups into it. External links are not substitutes:
   python3 tools/release.py assemble --spec SPEC.json --base BASE --output NEW_RELEASE
   python3 tools/release.py verify NEW_RELEASE
7. Wrap verified archives in native repository packages without rebuilding them.
   Verify signed metadata and exact payloads; retain source/packager identities.
8. Run the frozen certification policy against these exact bytes and retain all
   source, archive, recovery, backend and platform results with actual attempts.
   For a prepared workspace on another CI or a local scheduler:
   python3 tools/qualification_tasks.py plan --root . --profile core
   python3 tools/qualification_tasks.py list --root .
   Dispatch each listed physical execution to its required environment using the
   prepare/run commands in docs/certification.md. Preserve grouped logical reports,
   run identity and all companion evidence before using certify_release.py.
9. Test recovery with the original base unavailable:
   python3 tools/release.py recover NEW_RELEASE --output NEW_RECOVERY
   python3 tools/release.py verify-recovery NEW_RECOVERY --expected-release-sha256 TRUSTED_RELEASE_SHA256
   Retain the trusted original release.json digest independently; kit verification
   checks complete local inputs, not successful reconstruction or certification.
10. When separately authorized, publish immutable assets, reverify downloads,
    certify the delivered bytes and only then promote an eligible ordinary release.
    Experiments and incomplete qualification cannot become a stable release.

Every publication and report is append-only. Preserve earlier failures and releases.
SDK/source producers, local assembly, Debian repository creation, hosted delivery,
coverage and certification tools are included. Actual
execution and remaining environment qualification are documented in docs/validation.md.
See docs/releases.md, docs/sdk.md, docs/certification.md and docs/distribution.md.

View all seven hosts, including the checked-in offline snapshot: docs/screenshots.md
Original PNGs and provenance: docs/screenshots/
Verify the offline snapshot:
python3 -B tools/screenshots.py verify docs/screenshots

Regenerate with the existing hosted capture workflow on a selected source revision:
gh workflow run screenshots.yml --repo mirage335-colossus/software-foundation \
  --ref '<source branch or tag>' \
  -f native_recipe='<exact prepared Linux x64 GUI SDK recipe digest>' \
  -f wasm_recipe='<exact prepared browser SDK recipe digest>' \
  -f gui_input='{"source":"base","manifest_sha256":"<exact GUI group manifest digest>"}' \
  -f source=base -f jobs=auto -f linux_pool=standard -f execute=false

Replace placeholders with reviewed existing inputs; missing groups fail.
core_provider defaults rust. The exact checked-in native/Wasm Rust recipes are
derived unless native_rust_recipe/wasm_rust_recipe are supplied. Their complete
retained groups must exist in rust_source=base (default). For rust_source=retained,
supply rust_retained_inputs with exact native and wasm Rust producer requests.
Explicit core_provider=cpp selects the historical Rust-free capture route.
Optional tag must be a new screenshots- tag; empty uses the run and attempt.
For source=retained, also supply retained_inputs with exact native and wasm
version-2 requests, and the corresponding exact gui_input selector.
execute=false builds/captures and writes private draft release retention.
execute=true additionally publishes a non-Latest prerelease through release-publisher.
See docs/screenshots.md for prerequisites, exact-release download and refresh steps.

include_guard(GLOBAL)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/DependencyPaths.cmake")
set(FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX "" CACHE PATH "Explicit verified rootless native development tree")
if(FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX)
  if(FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT OR FOUNDATION_WINDOWS_DEPENDENCIES OR CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING OR NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Native development prefixes cannot be combined with a target SDK")
  endif()
  find_package(Python3 3.9 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
  execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/prepare_dependencies.py" verify "${FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX}"
    COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY OUTPUT_VARIABLE prefix_identity)
  string(JSON prefix_sha256 GET "${prefix_identity}" sha256)
  if(DEFINED FOUNDATION_CONFIGURED_DEPENDENCY_SHA256 AND NOT FOUNDATION_CONFIGURED_DEPENDENCY_SHA256 STREQUAL prefix_sha256)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Development prefix identity changed; configure a fresh build directory")
  endif()
  set(FOUNDATION_CONFIGURED_DEPENDENCY_SHA256 "${prefix_sha256}" CACHE INTERNAL "Configured native dependency bytes" FORCE)
  list(PREPEND CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "${FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX}/usr")
  # Older distro package configs can retain /usr/include. This native-only
  # overlay uses the verified headers before the host defaults; SDKs cannot mix.
  include_directories(SYSTEM "${FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX}/usr/include")
  if(CMAKE_LIBRARY_ARCHITECTURE AND IS_DIRECTORY "${FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX}/usr/include/${CMAKE_LIBRARY_ARCHITECTURE}")
    include_directories(SYSTEM "${FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX}/usr/include/${CMAKE_LIBRARY_ARCHITECTURE}")
  endif()
endif()
if(DEFINED FOUNDATION_CONFIGURED_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX AND NOT FOUNDATION_CONFIGURED_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX STREQUAL FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Development prefix changed; configure a fresh build directory")
endif()
set(FOUNDATION_CONFIGURED_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX "${FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX}" CACHE INTERNAL "Configured native dependency input" FORCE)
option(FOUNDATION_COMPILER_CACHE "Use an available ccache without requiring it" ON)
if(FOUNDATION_COMPILER_CACHE AND CMAKE_GENERATOR MATCHES "Ninja|Makefiles")
  find_program(FOUNDATION_CCACHE_PROGRAM NAMES ccache NO_CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH)
  if(FOUNDATION_CCACHE_PROGRAM)
    foreach(language C CXX)
      if(NOT CMAKE_${language}_COMPILER_LAUNCHER)
        set(CMAKE_${language}_COMPILER_LAUNCHER "${FOUNDATION_CCACHE_PROGRAM}")
      endif()
    endforeach()
  endif()
endif()

function(foundation_notice_file path)
  if(NOT IS_ABSOLUTE "${path}" OR NOT EXISTS "${path}" OR IS_DIRECTORY "${path}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "A dependency notice must be an existing absolute file: ${path}")
  endif()
  file(SHA256 "${path}" identity)
  set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY FOUNDATION_NOTICE_FILES "${path}")
  set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY FOUNDATION_NOTICE_HASHES "${identity}")
endfunction()

function(foundation_generated_application_archive target producer)
  get_target_property(imported "${target}" IMPORTED)
  get_target_property(type "${target}" TYPE)
  get_target_property(producer_type "${producer}" TYPE)
  get_target_property(dependencies "${target}" MANUALLY_ADDED_DEPENDENCIES)
  if(NOT imported OR NOT type STREQUAL "STATIC_LIBRARY" OR
      NOT producer_type STREQUAL "UTILITY" OR NOT producer IN_LIST dependencies)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "A generated application archive requires an imported static target and its utility producer")
  endif()
  get_target_property(configurations "${target}" IMPORTED_CONFIGURATIONS)
  get_target_property(receipts "${target}" FOUNDATION_GENERATED_RECEIPTS)
  get_target_property(inputs "${target}" FOUNDATION_GENERATED_INPUTS)
  get_target_property(verifier "${target}" FOUNDATION_GENERATED_VERIFIER)
  if(NOT configurations OR NOT receipts OR NOT inputs OR NOT verifier)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "A generated application archive requires declared configurations, inputs, receipts and verifier")
  endif()
  set(FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_BUILD "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
  foreach(configuration IN LISTS configurations)
    string(TOUPPER "${configuration}" upper)
    get_target_property(archive "${target}" "IMPORTED_LOCATION_${upper}")
    if(NOT IS_ABSOLUTE "${archive}" OR archive MATCHES "\\$<" OR
        NOT archive MATCHES "\\.(a|lib)$")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Generated application archive must have an exact per-configuration path: ${archive}")
    endif()
    set(FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_GENERATED_ARCHIVES "${archive}")
    foundation_is_generated_dependency("${archive}" checked)
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY FOUNDATION_GENERATED_ARCHIVES "${archive}")
  endforeach()
  set_property(TARGET "${target}" PROPERTY FOUNDATION_GENERATED_APPLICATION_ARCHIVE TRUE)
  set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY FOUNDATION_GENERATED_TARGETS "${target}")
  set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY FOUNDATION_GENERATED_PRODUCERS "${producer}")
endfunction()

# Call this at the beginning of every target-bearing subdirectory. A final
# completeness check rejects an unregistered directory rather than losing local
# imported targets, which are deliberately invisible to the parent directory.
function(foundation_register_build_directory)
  get_property(registered DIRECTORY PROPERTY FOUNDATION_POLICY_REGISTERED)
  if(registered)
    return()
  endif()
  set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY FOUNDATION_POLICY_REGISTERED TRUE)
  cmake_language(DEFER CALL _foundation_capture_directory_policy)
endfunction()

# A retained dependency with its own project() receives the same scoped guard
# without editing supplier source. Preserve any existing project hooks.
set(foundation_directory_hook "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/foundation-register-directory.cmake")
file(WRITE "${foundation_directory_hook}" "foundation_register_build_directory()\n")
list(APPEND CMAKE_PROJECT_INCLUDE_BEFORE "${foundation_directory_hook}")

function(_foundation_capture_directory_policy)
  get_property(captured DIRECTORY PROPERTY FOUNDATION_POLICY_CAPTURED)
  if(captured)
    return()
  endif()
  set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY FOUNDATION_POLICY_CAPTURED TRUE)
  get_property(targets DIRECTORY PROPERTY BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
  get_property(imported_targets DIRECTORY PROPERTY IMPORTED_TARGETS)
  list(APPEND targets ${imported_targets})
  string(SHA256 directory_id "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
  set(notices "")
  get_property(generated_targets GLOBAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION_GENERATED_TARGETS)
  if(FOUNDATION_GUI_DISTRIBUTABLE AND NOT FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT AND NOT FOUNDATION_WINDOWS_DEPENDENCIES)
    foreach(target IN LISTS imported_targets)
      get_target_property(type "${target}" TYPE)
      if(type MATCHES "^(STATIC_LIBRARY|SHARED_LIBRARY|UNKNOWN_LIBRARY)$" AND NOT target IN_LIST generated_targets)
        string(APPEND notices "list(APPEND command --library [==[$<TARGET_FILE:${target}>]==])\n")
      endif()
    endforeach()
  endif()
  set(notice_fragment "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/policy/${directory_id}-notices-$<CONFIG>.cmake")
  file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${notice_fragment}" CONTENT "${notices}")
  set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY FOUNDATION_NOTICE_FRAGMENTS "${notice_fragment}")
  if(FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    set(FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_SYSROOT "${CMAKE_SYSROOT}")
    set(FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")
    set(FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_BUILD "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
    set(FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_GUI "${FOUNDATION_GUI_SOURCE}")
    get_property(FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_GENERATED_ARCHIVES GLOBAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION_GENERATED_ARCHIVES)
    get_property(generated_targets GLOBAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION_GENERATED_TARGETS)
    set(check "include([==[${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_DIR}/DependencyPaths.cmake]==])\n")
    foreach(name SYSROOT SOURCE BUILD GUI)
      string(APPEND check "set(FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_${name} [==[${FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_${name}}]==])\n")
    endforeach()
    string(APPEND check "set(FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_GENERATED_ARCHIVES)\n")
    foreach(generated_target IN LISTS generated_targets)
      string(APPEND check "list(APPEND FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_GENERATED_ARCHIVES [==[$<TARGET_FILE:${generated_target}>]==])\n")
    endforeach()
    get_property(enabled_languages GLOBAL PROPERTY ENABLED_LANGUAGES)
    if(FOUNDATION_VERIFY_SDK AND "C" IN_LIST enabled_languages)
      file(READ "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}/sdk.json" sdk_metadata)
      string(JSON declared_c ERROR_VARIABLE c_error GET "${sdk_metadata}" target c_compiler)
      if(c_error)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "The selected SDK has no declared C compiler")
      endif()
      file(REAL_PATH "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}/${declared_c}" expected_c)
      file(REAL_PATH "${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}" actual_c)
      if(NOT actual_c STREQUAL expected_c)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "C compiler differs from the selected SDK")
      endif()
    endif()
    foreach(kind EXE SHARED MODULE STATIC)
      foreach(suffix "" _DEBUG _RELEASE _RELWITHDEBINFO _MINSIZEREL)
        if(CMAKE_${kind}_LINKER_FLAGS${suffix} MATCHES "(^|[ ;,:])(-L|--library-path|--sysroot)")
          message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK linker search overrides are unsupported; use verified targets")
        endif()
      endforeach()
    endforeach()
    foreach(language C CXX)
      foreach(suffix "" _DEBUG _RELEASE _RELWITHDEBINFO _MINSIZEREL)
        if(CMAKE_${language}_FLAGS${suffix} MATCHES "(^|[ ;])(-I|-L|-isystem|-iquote|--sysroot|/I)")
          message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK include/library search overrides are unsupported; use verified targets")
        endif()
      endforeach()
    endforeach()
    foreach(target IN LISTS targets)
      get_target_property(type "${target}" TYPE)
      get_target_property(imported "${target}" IMPORTED)
      if(imported AND NOT type STREQUAL "EXECUTABLE")
        get_target_property(configurations "${target}" IMPORTED_CONFIGURATIONS)
        set(properties IMPORTED_LOCATION IMPORTED_IMPLIB)
        foreach(configuration IN LISTS configurations CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
          string(TOUPPER "${configuration}" configuration)
          list(APPEND properties "IMPORTED_LOCATION_${configuration}" "IMPORTED_IMPLIB_${configuration}")
        endforeach()
        list(APPEND properties IMPORTED_LOCATION_DEBUG IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELEASE IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELWITHDEBINFO IMPORTED_LOCATION_MINSIZEREL)
        foreach(property IN LISTS properties)
          get_target_property(value "${target}" "${property}")
          if(value AND NOT value MATCHES "\\$<")
            foundation_check_dependency(library "${value}")
            foundation_is_generated_dependency("${value}" generated)
            if(NOT generated)
              file(SHA256 "${value}" identity)
              string(APPEND check "foundation_check_dependency_hash([==[${value}]==] ${identity})\n")
            endif()
          endif()
        endforeach()
      endif()
      foreach(property COMPILE_OPTIONS INTERFACE_COMPILE_OPTIONS LINK_OPTIONS INTERFACE_LINK_OPTIONS)
        get_target_property(options "${target}" "${property}")
        if(options AND options MATCHES "(^|[ ;,:>])(-I|-L|-isystem|-iquote|-idirafter|--library-path|--sysroot)")
          message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK target search overrides are unsupported; use include and link target properties")
        endif()
      endforeach()
      foreach(property INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES INTERFACE_SYSTEM_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES LINK_DIRECTORIES INTERFACE_LINK_DIRECTORIES LINK_LIBRARIES INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)
        get_target_property(values "${target}" "${property}")
        if(NOT values)
          continue()
        endif()
        if(property MATCHES "INCLUDE")
          set(kind include)
        else()
          set(kind library)
        endif()
        foreach(value IN LISTS values)
          if(NOT value MATCHES "\\$<")
            foundation_check_dependency_values("${kind}" "${value}")
            if(kind STREQUAL "library" AND IS_ABSOLUTE "${value}" AND NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${value}")
              foundation_is_generated_dependency("${value}" generated)
              if(NOT generated)
                file(SHA256 "${value}" identity)
                string(APPEND check "foundation_check_dependency_hash([==[${value}]==] ${identity})\n")
              endif()
            endif()
          endif()
        endforeach()
        string(APPEND check "foundation_check_dependency_values(${kind} [==[$<TARGET_GENEX_EVAL:${target},$<TARGET_PROPERTY:${target},${property}>>]==])\n")
      endforeach()
    endforeach()
    set(check_file "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/policy/${directory_id}-dependencies-$<CONFIG>.cmake")
    file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${check_file}" CONTENT "${check}")
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_FRAGMENTS "${check_file}")
  endif()
endfunction()

function(_foundation_directory_targets directory output)
  get_property(targets DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
  get_property(imported DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY IMPORTED_TARGETS)
  get_property(registered DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY FOUNDATION_POLICY_REGISTERED)
  if((targets OR imported) AND NOT registered)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Target directory must call foundation_register_build_directory(): ${directory}")
  endif()
  get_property(children DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY SUBDIRECTORIES)
  foreach(child IN LISTS children)
    _foundation_directory_targets("${child}" nested)
    list(APPEND targets ${nested})
  endforeach()
  set(${output} "${targets}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(foundation_finalize_build_policy)
  _foundation_capture_directory_policy()
  set(FOUNDATION_NOTICE_MANIFEST "" CACHE FILEPATH "Reviewed hash-bound notices for dependencies without distro ownership")
  _foundation_directory_targets("${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}" targets)
  list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES targets)
  set(notice_command "set(command [==[${Python3_EXECUTABLE}]==] [==[${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/package_notices.py]==] --output \"\$ENV{DESTDIR}\${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${CMAKE_INSTALL_DOCDIR}/dependency-notices\")\n")
  if(FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT)
    string(APPEND notice_command "list(APPEND command --sdk [==[${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}]==])\n")
  elseif(FOUNDATION_WINDOWS_DEPENDENCIES)
    string(APPEND notice_command "list(APPEND command --windows-dependencies [==[${FOUNDATION_WINDOWS_DEPENDENCIES}]==])\n")
  endif()
  if(FOUNDATION_NOTICE_MANIFEST)
    string(APPEND notice_command "list(APPEND command --manifest [==[${FOUNDATION_NOTICE_MANIFEST}]==])\n")
  endif()
  if(FOUNDATION_PORTABLE AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    string(APPEND notice_command "list(APPEND command --runtime-inventory \"\$ENV{DESTDIR}\${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib/runtime/runtime-inventory.json\")\n")
    foreach(root IN LISTS FOUNDATION_RUNTIME_ROOTS)
      string(APPEND notice_command "list(APPEND command --runtime-root [==[${root}]==])\n")
    endforeach()
  endif()
  get_property(notices GLOBAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION_NOTICE_FILES)
  get_property(hashes GLOBAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION_NOTICE_HASHES)
  list(LENGTH notices count)
  if(count GREATER 0)
    math(EXPR last "${count}-1")
    foreach(index RANGE 0 ${last})
      list(GET notices ${index} notice)
      list(GET hashes ${index} identity)
      string(APPEND notice_command "list(APPEND command --file [==[${notice}]==] ${identity})\n")
    endforeach()
  endif()
  if(NOT FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT AND NOT FOUNDATION_WINDOWS_DEPENDENCIES)
    if(FOUNDATION_PORTABLE AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
      foreach(name libstdc++.a libgcc.a libgcc_eh.a)
        execute_process(COMMAND "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}" "-print-file-name=${name}"
          OUTPUT_VARIABLE library OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
        if(NOT IS_ABSOLUTE "${library}" OR NOT EXISTS "${library}")
          message(FATAL_ERROR "Cannot identify selected static runtime: ${name}")
        endif()
        string(APPEND notice_command "list(APPEND command --library [==[${library}]==])\n")
      endforeach()
    endif()
    get_property(fragments GLOBAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION_NOTICE_FRAGMENTS)
    foreach(fragment IN LISTS fragments)
      string(APPEND notice_command "include([==[${fragment}]==])\n")
    endforeach()
  endif()
  string(APPEND notice_command "execute_process(COMMAND \${command} RESULT_VARIABLE status)\nif(NOT status EQUAL 0)\n  message(FATAL_ERROR \"Dependency notice staging failed\")\nendif()\n")
  set(notice_script "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/install-notices-$<CONFIG>.cmake")
  file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${notice_script}" CONTENT "${notice_command}")
  install(SCRIPT "${notice_script}")
  if(FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX)
    add_custom_target(foundation-prefix-check ALL COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B
      "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/prepare_dependencies.py" verify "${FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX}" --expected-sha256 "${FOUNDATION_CONFIGURED_DEPENDENCY_SHA256}" VERBATIM)
    foreach(target IN LISTS targets)
      get_target_property(imported "${target}" IMPORTED)
      get_target_property(type "${target}" TYPE)
      if(NOT imported AND NOT type STREQUAL "INTERFACE_LIBRARY" AND NOT type STREQUAL "UTILITY")
        add_dependencies("${target}" foundation-prefix-check)
      endif()
    endforeach()
    install(CODE "execute_process(COMMAND [==[${Python3_EXECUTABLE}]==] -B [==[${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/prepare_dependencies.py]==] verify [==[${FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_PREFIX}]==] --expected-sha256 ${FOUNDATION_CONFIGURED_DEPENDENCY_SHA256} COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)")
  endif()
  # Directory fragments were captured where their local imports are visible.
  if(FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    set(check "")
    if(FOUNDATION_VERIFY_SDK)
      string(APPEND check "execute_process(COMMAND [==[${Python3_EXECUTABLE}]==] -B [==[${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_DIR}/../tools/sdk_verify.py]==] [==[${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}]==] COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY OUTPUT_QUIET)\n")
    endif()
    get_property(fragments GLOBAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_FRAGMENTS)
    foreach(fragment IN LISTS fragments)
      string(APPEND check "include([==[${fragment}]==])\n")
    endforeach()
    set(check_file "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dependency-paths-$<CONFIG>.cmake")
    file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${check_file}" CONTENT "${check}")
    add_custom_target(foundation-dependency-check ALL COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -P "${check_file}" VERBATIM)
    get_property(generated_producers GLOBAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION_GENERATED_PRODUCERS)
    if(generated_producers)
      add_dependencies(foundation-dependency-check ${generated_producers})
    endif()
    foreach(target IN LISTS targets)
      get_target_property(imported "${target}" IMPORTED)
      get_target_property(type "${target}" TYPE)
      if(NOT imported AND NOT type STREQUAL "INTERFACE_LIBRARY" AND NOT type STREQUAL "UTILITY")
        add_dependencies("${target}" foundation-dependency-check)
      endif()
    endforeach()
    install(SCRIPT "${check_file}")
  endif()
endfunction()

  set_and_check(_foundation_rust_archive "@PACKAGE_CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR@/@FOUNDATION_RUST_ARCHIVE_NAME@")
  add_library(foundation::rust_component STATIC IMPORTED)
  set_target_properties(foundation::rust_component PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_LOCATION "${_foundation_rust_archive}"
    INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES "@FOUNDATION_RUST_NATIVE_LIBRARIES@"
    INTERFACE_LINK_OPTIONS "@FOUNDATION_RUST_LINK_OPTIONS@")
  unset(_foundation_rust_archive)
endif()

# The imported archive cannot change its consumer's runtime automatically.
# Apply the recorded ABI choice explicitly to each executable/library consumer.
function(foundation_apply_runtime target)
  if(EMSCRIPTEN)
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fexceptions)
    target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -fexceptions -sASSERTIONS=1)
  elseif(MSVC AND Foundation_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY)
    set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "${Foundation_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY}")
  elseif(Foundation_PORTABLE)
    foundation_require_static_gnu_runtime()
    foundation_link_static_gnu_runtime(${target} PRIVATE)
  endif()
endfunction()

set(FOUNDATION_RUST_SDK_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Verified retained Rust extension SDK")
set(FOUNDATION_RUST_TARGET "" CACHE STRING "Explicit Rust target triple, or the matching platform default")

function(foundation_rust_component core)
  foreach(field SDK_RECIPE_ID SDK_MANIFEST_SHA256 COMPILER_VERSION COMPILER_SHA256 SELECTED_TARGET)
    set(FOUNDATION_RUST_${field} none PARENT_SCOPE)
  endforeach()
  if(NOT FOUNDATION_CORE_PROVIDER STREQUAL "rust")
    return()
  endif()
  if(CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The Rust component uses native objects without cross-language LTO")
  endif()
  if(EMSCRIPTEN)
    set(default_target wasm32-unknown-emscripten)
  elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Windows" AND MSVC AND CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
    if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE_ID MATCHES "ARM64" AND
        NOT CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM MATCHES "ARM64" AND
        CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64|amd64)$")
      set(default_target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)
    endif()
  elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64|amd64)$")
      set(default_target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)
    elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(aarch64|arm64|ARM64)$")
      set(default_target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu)
    endif()
  endif()
  if(NOT default_target)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The Rust provider requires a declared Linux GNU, Windows x64 MSVC or Emscripten target; use FOUNDATION_CORE_PROVIDER=cpp for this platform")
  endif()
  if(FOUNDATION_RUST_TARGET AND NOT FOUNDATION_RUST_TARGET STREQUAL default_target)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Rust target does not match the selected C++ target: ${FOUNDATION_RUST_TARGET} != ${default_target}")
  endif()
  set(target "${default_target}")
  set(sdk_recipe none)
  set(sdk_sha256 none)
  set(sdk_arguments)
  set(cpp_sdk "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}")
  if(NOT cpp_sdk AND FOUNDATION_WINDOWS_DEPENDENCIES)
    set(cpp_sdk "${FOUNDATION_WINDOWS_DEPENDENCIES}")
  endif()
  if(FOUNDATION_RUST_SDK_ROOT)
    set(verify_command "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/rust_sdk.py"
      verify --root "${FOUNDATION_RUST_SDK_ROOT}" --target "${target}")
    if(cpp_sdk)
      list(APPEND verify_command --cpp-sdk "${cpp_sdk}")
    endif()
    execute_process(COMMAND ${verify_command} OUTPUT_VARIABLE sdk
      COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE)
    string(JSON rustc GET "${sdk}" rustc)
    string(JSON cargo GET "${sdk}" cargo)
    string(JSON sdk_recipe GET "${sdk}" metadata recipe_id)
    string(JSON sdk_sha256 GET "${sdk}" sha256)
    list(APPEND sdk_arguments --sdk-root "${FOUNDATION_RUST_SDK_ROOT}")
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${FOUNDATION_RUST_SDK_ROOT}/rust-sdk.json")
  else()
    if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" OR CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING OR cpp_sdk)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "This Rust target requires FOUNDATION_RUST_SDK_ROOT; native Linux distribution tools are available only without a target SDK. Prepare the retained Rust extension or explicitly select FOUNDATION_CORE_PROVIDER=cpp")
    endif()
    find_program(FOUNDATION_RUST_RUSTC NAMES rustc NO_CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH)
    find_program(FOUNDATION_RUST_CARGO NAMES cargo NO_CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH)
    if(NOT FOUNDATION_RUST_RUSTC OR NOT FOUNDATION_RUST_CARGO)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Rust is the default core provider but rustc/Cargo are missing; provide a retained FOUNDATION_RUST_SDK_ROOT or native distribution tools, or explicitly select FOUNDATION_CORE_PROVIDER=cpp")
    endif()
    set(rustc "${FOUNDATION_RUST_RUSTC}")
    set(cargo "${FOUNDATION_RUST_CARGO}")
  endif()
  if(cpp_sdk)
    list(APPEND sdk_arguments --cpp-sdk-root "${cpp_sdk}")
  endif()
  if(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(configurations ${CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES})
  elseif(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(configurations "${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
  else()
    set(configurations NoConfig)
  endif()
  add_library(foundation::rust_component STATIC IMPORTED)
  set(receipts)
  set(byproducts)
  set(all_inputs)
  set(native_libraries)
  foreach(configuration IN LISTS configurations)
    string(TOLOWER "${configuration}" profile)
    if(NOT profile STREQUAL "debug")
      set(profile release)
    endif()
    set(config_file "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/rust/${configuration}/config.json")
    execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/rust_build.py"
      describe --source-root "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}" --build-dir "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/rust/${configuration}"
      --target "${target}" --cargo "${cargo}" --rustc "${rustc}" --profile "${profile}"
      ${sdk_arguments} --output "${config_file}" COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
    file(READ "${config_file}" description)
    string(JSON archive GET "${description}" artifact_path)
    string(JSON receipt GET "${description}" receipt_path)
    string(JSON compiler_version GET "${description}" tools rustc version)
    string(JSON compiler_host GET "${description}" tools rustc host)
    string(JSON compiler_sha256 GET "${description}" tools rustc sha256)
    string(JSON cargo_sha256 GET "${description}" tools cargo sha256)
    string(TOUPPER "${configuration}" upper)
    set_property(TARGET foundation::rust_component APPEND PROPERTY IMPORTED_CONFIGURATIONS "${configuration}")
    set_property(TARGET foundation::rust_component PROPERTY "IMPORTED_LOCATION_${upper}" "${archive}")
    list(APPEND receipts "${receipt}")
    if(configuration STREQUAL "NoConfig")
      set(config_expression "")
    else()
      set(config_expression "${configuration}")
    endif()
    list(APPEND byproducts "$<$<CONFIG:${config_expression}>:${archive}>" "$<$<CONFIG:${config_expression}>:${receipt}>")
    get_filename_component(archive_name "${archive}" NAME)
    foreach(field source_inputs native_static_libs notice_files)
      string(JSON count LENGTH "${description}" "${field}")
      set(values)
      if(count GREATER 0)
        math(EXPR last "${count}-1")
        foreach(index RANGE 0 ${last})
          string(JSON value GET "${description}" "${field}" ${index})
          list(APPEND values "${value}")
        endforeach()
      endif()
      if(field STREQUAL "source_inputs")
        list(APPEND all_inputs ${values})
      elseif(field STREQUAL "notice_files")
        foreach(notice IN LISTS values)
          foundation_notice_file("${notice}")
        endforeach()
      elseif(native_libraries AND NOT native_libraries STREQUAL values)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Rust native library requirements differ between configurations")
      else()
        set(native_libraries "${values}")
      endif()
    endforeach()
  endforeach()
  set(identity "${target};${rustc};${cargo};${compiler_sha256};${cargo_sha256};${sdk_sha256}")
  string(SHA256 identity "${identity}")
  if(DEFINED FOUNDATION_CONFIGURED_RUST_IDENTITY AND NOT FOUNDATION_CONFIGURED_RUST_IDENTITY STREQUAL identity)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Rust toolchain identity changed; configure a fresh build directory")
  endif()
  set(FOUNDATION_CONFIGURED_RUST_IDENTITY "${identity}" CACHE INTERNAL "Configured Rust toolchain" FORCE)
  file(GLOB_RECURSE rust_inputs CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/rust/*.rs" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/rust/*.toml" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/rust/Cargo.lock")
  set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${all_inputs} ${rust_inputs}
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/rust_build.py" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/rust_sdk.py")
  set(selected_configuration "$<IF:$<BOOL:$<CONFIG>>,$<CONFIG>,NoConfig>")
  set(selected_config "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/rust/${selected_configuration}/config.json")
  set(selected_archive "$<TARGET_FILE:foundation::rust_component>")
  add_custom_target(foundation-rust
    COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/rust_build.py" build --config "${selected_config}"
    COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/rust_build.py" verify --config "${selected_config}"
    BYPRODUCTS ${byproducts}
    VERBATIM)
  add_dependencies(foundation::rust_component foundation-rust)
  if(BUILD_TESTING AND NOT EMSCRIPTEN AND compiler_host STREQUAL target)
    add_test(NAME rust.unit COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/rust_build.py"
      test --config "${selected_config}")
    set_tests_properties(rust.unit PROPERTIES LABELS "rust;unit" TIMEOUT 180 RESOURCE_LOCK rust-build)
    foundation_test_prerequisites(rust.unit foundation-rust)
  endif()
  set_target_properties(foundation::rust_component PROPERTIES
    FOUNDATION_GENERATED_RECEIPTS "${receipts}" FOUNDATION_GENERATED_INPUTS "${all_inputs}"
    FOUNDATION_GENERATED_VERIFIER "${Python3_EXECUTABLE};-B;${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/rust_build.py;verify;--config;${selected_config}"
    INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES "${native_libraries}")
  set(link_options)
  if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    list(APPEND link_options "LINKER:--exclude-libs,${archive_name}")
    set_property(TARGET foundation::rust_component PROPERTY INTERFACE_LINK_OPTIONS "${link_options}")
  endif()
  foundation_generated_application_archive(foundation::rust_component foundation-rust)
  target_compile_definitions(${core} PRIVATE FOUNDATION_USE_RUST=1)
  target_link_libraries(${core} PRIVATE foundation::rust_component)

# Target sysroot directories are compiler inputs, never runtime loader paths:
# adding one to RPATH could load the SDK libc into an ordinary host process.
if(FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  foreach(language C CXX)
    foreach(directory lib lib64 usr/lib usr/lib64)
      list(APPEND CMAKE_${language}_IMPLICIT_LINK_DIRECTORIES "${CMAKE_SYSROOT}/${directory}")
    endforeach()
    list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES CMAKE_${language}_IMPLICIT_LINK_DIRECTORIES)
  endforeach()
endif()

function(foundation_sdk_runtime target)
  if(NOT FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT OR NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    return()
  endif()
  if(NOT FOUNDATION_PORTABLE)
    get_property(checked GLOBAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION_SDK_STATIC_RUNTIME_CHECKED)
    if(NOT checked)
      foundation_require_static_gnu_runtime()
      set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION_SDK_STATIC_RUNTIME_CHECKED TRUE)
    endif()
    foundation_link_static_gnu_runtime(${target} PRIVATE)
  endif()
  get_target_property(type "${target}" TYPE)
  if(NOT type STREQUAL "EXECUTABLE")
    return()
  endif()
  if(NOT target MATCHES "^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.+-]*$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unsafe SDK runtime target name: ${target}")
  endif()
  get_target_property(registered "${target}" FOUNDATION_SDK_RUNTIME)
  if(registered)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK runtime already registered: ${target}")
  endif()
  set_property(TARGET "${target}" PROPERTY FOUNDATION_SDK_RUNTIME TRUE)
  # Build with CMake's install-RPATH encoder to avoid editable build-RPATH
  # padding and older Ninja generators' manual LINKER:$ORIGIN escaping bug.
  # Finalization below preserves the caller's installed policy before selecting
  # the exact private build path. Only installed copies need a path rewrite.
  # DT_RPATH is inherited by indirect private dependencies.
  target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE "LINKER:--disable-new-dtags")
  set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES SKIP_BUILD_RPATH TRUE
    BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH TRUE)
  set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY FOUNDATION_SDK_ALL_RUNTIME_TARGETS "${target}")
  set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY FOUNDATION_SDK_RUNTIME_TARGETS "${target}")
  get_property(scheduled DIRECTORY PROPERTY FOUNDATION_SDK_RUNTIME_SCHEDULED)
  if(NOT scheduled)
    set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY FOUNDATION_SDK_RUNTIME_SCHEDULED TRUE)
    cmake_language(DEFER CALL _foundation_finalize_sdk_runtime)
  endif()
endfunction()

# These literals enter generated installation code. Spaces remain supported;
# reject CMake expansion/quoting/list syntax instead of interpreting it later.
function(_foundation_sdk_install_literal value description)
  if(value MATCHES "[\"\\\\;$\n\r]")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unsupported metacharacter in SDK ${description}")
  endif()
endfunction()

function(_foundation_finalize_sdk_runtime)
  get_property(targets DIRECTORY PROPERTY FOUNDATION_SDK_RUNTIME_TARGETS)
  file(SHA256 "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}/sdk.json" manifest)
  set(helper "${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_DIR}/../tools/sdk_build_runtime.py")
  foreach(target IN LISTS targets)
    # Read the final policy after foundation_options and caller overrides. With
    # CMake's padding disabled, installation may shorten this string but cannot
    # grow it. Fail at configuration rather than truncate or rewrite build bytes.
    get_target_property(install_rpath "${target}" INSTALL_RPATH)
    if(NOT install_rpath)
      set(install_rpath "")
    endif()
    string(REPLACE ";" ":" install_rpath "${install_rpath}")
    string(LENGTH "${install_rpath}" install_length)
    string(LENGTH "$ORIGIN/.sdk-runtime/${target}" build_length)
    if(install_rpath MATCHES "\\$<" OR install_length GREATER build_length)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK installed RPATH for ${target} must be a literal no longer than its private build RPATH")
    endif()
    string(REPLACE "$ORIGIN" "" literal_rpath "${install_rpath}")
    _foundation_sdk_install_literal("${literal_rpath}" "installed RPATH")
    set(configurations DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL ${CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES} ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE})
    set(name_properties OUTPUT_NAME RUNTIME_OUTPUT_NAME PREFIX SUFFIX)
    foreach(configuration IN LISTS configurations)
      string(TOUPPER "${configuration}" configuration)
      list(APPEND name_properties "OUTPUT_NAME_${configuration}" "RUNTIME_OUTPUT_NAME_${configuration}" "${configuration}_POSTFIX")
    endforeach()
    foreach(property IN LISTS name_properties)
      get_target_property(value "${target}" "${property}")
      if(value)
        _foundation_sdk_install_literal("${value}" "executable name")
      endif()
    endforeach()
    set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES FOUNDATION_SDK_INSTALL_RPATH "${install_rpath}"
      INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/.sdk-runtime/${target}" INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH FALSE)
    # Components do not create a dependency under CMP0112 NEW (CMake >=3.24).
    # TARGET_FILE here would create a target/guard dependency cycle.
    add_custom_target("foundation-sdk-runtime-${target}"
      COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${helper}" --guard
        --sdk "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}" --manifest-sha256 "${manifest}"
        --executable "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target}>/$<TARGET_FILE_NAME:${target}>"
        --target "${target}" --processor "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}"
      COMMENT "Checking SDK development runtime for ${target}" VERBATIM)
    add_dependencies("${target}" "foundation-sdk-runtime-${target}")
    add_custom_command(TARGET "${target}" POST_BUILD
      COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${helper}"
        --sdk "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}" --manifest-sha256 "${manifest}"
        --executable "$<TARGET_FILE:${target}>" --target "${target}"
        --processor "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}"
      COMMENT "Auditing private SDK development runtime for ${target}" VERBATIM)
    set_property(TARGET "${target}" APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS
      "${helper}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_DIR}/../tools/stage_runtime.py"
      "${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_DIR}/../tools/verify_abi.py"
      "${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_FILE}")
  endforeach()
endfunction()

# Call after target install rules and before installed runtime staging/auditing.
# Only destinations recorded by this install invocation are eligible; absent
# components, uninstalled test targets and preexisting unrelated files are ignored.
function(foundation_install_sdk_runtime)
  if(NOT FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT OR NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    return()
  endif()
  _foundation_sdk_install_literal("${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}" "installation directory")
  _foundation_sdk_install_literal("${CMAKE_EXECUTABLE_SUFFIX}" "executable suffix")
  get_property(targets GLOBAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION_SDK_ALL_RUNTIME_TARGETS)
  set(preflight "set(foundation_sdk_installed_destinations)\n")
  set(rewrite "")
  foreach(target IN LISTS targets)
    if(IS_ABSOLUTE "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}")
      set(destination "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/$<TARGET_FILE_NAME:${target}>")
    else()
      set(destination "\${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/$<TARGET_FILE_NAME:${target}>")
    endif()
    string(APPEND preflight "
      set(destination \"${destination}\")
      list(FIND CMAKE_INSTALL_MANIFEST_FILES \"\${destination}\" installed_index)
      if(NOT installed_index EQUAL -1)
        list(FIND foundation_sdk_installed_destinations \"\${destination}\" duplicate_index)
        if(NOT duplicate_index EQUAL -1)
          message(FATAL_ERROR \"Ambiguous installed SDK executable destination: \${destination}\")
        endif()
        list(APPEND foundation_sdk_installed_destinations \"\${destination}\")
      endif()
    ")
    string(APPEND rewrite "
      set(destination \"${destination}\")
      list(FIND CMAKE_INSTALL_MANIFEST_FILES \"\${destination}\" installed_index)
      if(NOT installed_index EQUAL -1)
        if(IS_SYMLINK \"\$ENV{DESTDIR}\${destination}\")
          message(FATAL_ERROR \"Installed SDK executable must not be a symlink\")
        endif()
        file(RPATH_CHANGE FILE \"\$ENV{DESTDIR}\${destination}\"
          OLD_RPATH \"\$ORIGIN/.sdk-runtime/${target}\"
          NEW_RPATH \"$<TARGET_PROPERTY:${target},FOUNDATION_SDK_INSTALL_RPATH>\")
      endif()
    ")
  endforeach()
  install(CODE "${preflight}${rewrite}" ALL_COMPONENTS)
endfunction()

include_guard(GLOBAL)

# Compiler identity alone does not identify its selected C++ standard library.
# Call once after selecting the compiler, flags and portable policy. Never cache
# a successful probe across reconfiguration with different -stdlib/toolchain flags.
function(foundation_require_static_gnu_runtime)
  if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" OR
      NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "^(GNU|Clang)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Portable native builds require Linux with the GNU C++ runtime, or MSVC on Windows; declare and qualify another runtime policy before enabling it")
  endif()
  include(CheckCXXSourceCompiles)
  set(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE_TARGET_TYPE STATIC_LIBRARY)
  set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_QUIET TRUE)
  unset(foundation_selected_gnu_runtime CACHE)
  check_cxx_source_compiles("#include <cstddef>
#ifndef __GLIBCXX__
#error The selected standard library is not libstdc++
#endif
int main() { return 0; }" foundation_selected_gnu_runtime)
  set(selected "${foundation_selected_gnu_runtime}")
  unset(foundation_selected_gnu_runtime CACHE)
  if(NOT selected)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Portable Linux builds require the selected libstdc++ headers and static GNU runtime; libc++ and other runtime policies are not qualified")
  endif()
endfunction()

function(foundation_link_static_gnu_runtime target visibility)
  target_link_options(${target} ${visibility} -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc
    "LINKER:--exclude-libs,libstdc++.a:libgcc.a:libgcc_eh.a")
endfunction()

include_guard(GLOBAL)

# Register every test explicitly, including scripts with no compiled prerequisites.
# Labels select local development groups; candidate ownership is independently
# derived from the complete inventory by test_plan.py.
function(foundation_test_prerequisites name)
  if(NOT TEST "${name}" OR NOT name MATCHES "^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.+-]*$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Register an existing, safely named test: ${name}")
  endif()
  string(SHA256 key "${name}")
  get_property(known GLOBAL PROPERTY "FOUNDATION_TEST_${key}_DIRECTORY" SET)
  if(known)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Duplicate test prerequisite declaration: ${name}")
  endif()
  set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY FOUNDATION_REGISTERED_TESTS "${name}")
  set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY "FOUNDATION_TEST_${key}_DIRECTORY" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
  set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY "FOUNDATION_TEST_${key}_TARGETS" "${ARGN}")
  get_property(capture_scheduled DIRECTORY PROPERTY FOUNDATION_DIRECTORY_TESTS SET)
  set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY FOUNDATION_DIRECTORY_TESTS "${name}")
  if(NOT capture_scheduled)
    cmake_language(DEFER CALL _foundation_capture_test_labels)
  endif()
endfunction()

# TEST DIRECTORY requires CMake 3.28. Read final labels in their own directory
# instead, after all local set_tests_properties calls. No deferred local variable
# arguments are needed; each directory retains its own explicit registration list.
function(_foundation_capture_test_labels)
  get_property(names DIRECTORY PROPERTY FOUNDATION_DIRECTORY_TESTS)
  foreach(name IN LISTS names)
    string(SHA256 key "${name}")
    get_property(labels TEST "${name}" PROPERTY LABELS)
    set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY "FOUNDATION_TEST_${key}_LABELS" "${labels}")
  endforeach()
endfunction()

function(_foundation_collect_tests directory output)
  get_property(tests DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY TESTS)
  get_property(children DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY SUBDIRECTORIES)
  foreach(child IN LISTS children)
    _foundation_collect_tests("${child}" nested)
    list(APPEND tests ${nested})
  endforeach()
  set(${output} "${tests}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(foundation_finalize_test_prerequisites)
  _foundation_collect_tests("${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}" declared)
  get_property(registered GLOBAL PROPERTY FOUNDATION_REGISTERED_TESTS)
  list(SORT declared)
  list(SORT registered)
  if(NOT "${declared}" STREQUAL "${registered}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Every CTest case needs exactly one foundation_test_prerequisites declaration. Declared: ${declared}; registered: ${registered}")
  endif()
  set(inventory "{}")
  set(all_targets "")
  foreach(name IN LISTS registered)
    string(SHA256 key "${name}")
    get_property(targets GLOBAL PROPERTY "FOUNDATION_TEST_${key}_TARGETS")
    list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES targets)
    list(SORT targets)
    set(values "[]")
    set(index 0)
    foreach(target IN LISTS targets)
      if(NOT TARGET "${target}" OR NOT target MATCHES "^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.+-]*$")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Unknown or unsafe test prerequisite: ${name} -> ${target}")
      endif()
      string(JSON values SET "${values}" ${index} "\"${target}\"")
      math(EXPR index "${index}+1")
    endforeach()
    string(JSON inventory SET "${inventory}" "${name}" "${values}")
    get_property(labels GLOBAL PROPERTY "FOUNDATION_TEST_${key}_LABELS")
    foreach(label core tools integration fast gui)
      if(label IN_LIST labels)
        list(APPEND group_${label} ${targets})
      endif()
    endforeach()
    list(APPEND all_targets ${targets})
  endforeach()
  add_custom_target(foundation-tests DEPENDS ${all_targets})
  foreach(label core tools integration fast gui)
    add_custom_target(foundation-tests-${label} DEPENDS ${group_${label}})
  endforeach()
  if(TARGET foundation-gui-tests)
    add_dependencies(foundation-gui-tests foundation-tests-gui)
  endif()
  set(FOUNDATION_HAS_TEST_PREREQUISITES ON CACHE INTERNAL "Complete generated test prerequisite inventory" FORCE)
  file(WRITE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/test-prerequisites.json"
    "{\"schema_version\":1,\"tests\":${inventory}}\n")
endfunction()

# Prepared SDKs are explicit inputs. This file never bootstraps dependencies.
set(ENV{PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE} "1")
if(NOT FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT to a prepared SDK")
endif()
file(REAL_PATH "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}" FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT)
get_property(_nested GLOBAL PROPERTY IN_TRY_COMPILE)
if(NOT _nested)
  find_program(_sdk_python NAMES python3 python REQUIRED NO_CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH)
  execute_process(COMMAND "${_sdk_python}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../tools/sdk_verify.py"
    "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}" RESULT_VARIABLE _valid)
  if(NOT _valid EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK validation failed")
  endif()
endif()
file(READ "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}/sdk.json" _sdk)
string(JSON _schema GET "${_sdk}" schema_version)
if(NOT _schema EQUAL 1)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Unsupported SDK manifest schema")
endif()
foreach(_key system processor sysroot cxx_compiler)
  string(JSON _${_key} GET "${_sdk}" target ${_key})
endforeach()
if(_system STREQUAL "Emscripten")
  string(JSON _toolchain GET "${_sdk}" target toolchain)
  file(REAL_PATH "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}/${_toolchain}" _wasm_toolchain)
  cmake_path(IS_PREFIX FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT "${_wasm_toolchain}" NORMALIZE _inside)
  if(NOT _inside OR NOT EXISTS "${_wasm_toolchain}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing or escaping browser SDK toolchain")
  endif()
  set(ENV{EM_CONFIG} "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}/.emscripten")
  set(ENV{EM_CACHE} "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}/cache")
  set(ENV{EM_FROZEN_CACHE} "1")
  set(FOUNDATION_NODE_EXECUTABLE "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}/node/bin/node" CACHE FILEPATH "Retained target runtime" FORCE)
  # Keep configuration probes on the same warmed cache variant as applications.
  # Assertions remain enabled in Release as part of this prepared SDK contract.
  set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_INIT "-fexceptions")
  set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_INIT "-sASSERTIONS=1")
  include("${_wasm_toolchain}")
  # Supplier CMake sets direct launcher paths; route every later Ninja command
  # through the retained wrappers so frozen-cache settings survive configuration.
  set(CMAKE_USER_MAKE_RULES_OVERRIDE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/emscripten-rules.cmake")
  include("${CMAKE_USER_MAKE_RULES_OVERRIDE}")
  list(APPEND CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE_PLATFORM_VARIABLES FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT)
  return()
elseif(NOT _system STREQUAL "Linux")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Use the native Windows compiler with its verified dependency group")
endif()
string(JSON _c_compiler ERROR_VARIABLE _missing_c GET "${_sdk}" target c_compiler)
set(_sdk_paths sysroot cxx_compiler)
if(NOT _missing_c)
  list(APPEND _sdk_paths c_compiler)
endif()
foreach(_key IN LISTS _sdk_paths)
  if(IS_ABSOLUTE "${_${_key}}" OR "${_${_key}}" MATCHES "(^|/)\\.\\.(/|$)")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK paths must remain relative to the SDK")
  endif()
  file(REAL_PATH "${FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT}/${_${_key}}" _resolved)
  cmake_path(IS_PREFIX FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT "${_resolved}" NORMALIZE _inside)
  if(NOT _inside OR NOT EXISTS "${_resolved}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing or escaped SDK path")
  endif()
  set(_${_key} "${_resolved}")
endforeach()
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME "${_system}")
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR "${_processor}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER "${_cxx_compiler}")
if(_missing_c)
  # C++-only legacy SDKs remain usable, but a later enable_language(C) must
  # never discover an unrelated host compiler. CMake diagnoses this absent path.
  set(_c_compiler "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/SDK-manifest-does-not-declare-a-C-compiler")
  if(EXISTS "${_c_compiler}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Reserved undeclared C compiler path must remain absent")
  endif()
endif()
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER "${_c_compiler}" CACHE FILEPATH "Declared SDK C compiler" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER "${_c_compiler}")
set(CMAKE_SYSROOT "${_sysroot}")
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH "${CMAKE_SYSROOT}")
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM NEVER)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_LIBRARY ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_INCLUDE ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PACKAGE ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_USE_PACKAGE_REGISTRY OFF)
set(CMAKE_FIND_USE_SYSTEM_PACKAGE_REGISTRY OFF)
list(APPEND CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE_PLATFORM_VARIABLES FOUNDATION_SDK_ROOT)

set(ENV{PKG_CONFIG_SYSROOT_DIR} "${CMAKE_SYSROOT}")
set(ENV{PKG_CONFIG_PATH} "")

set(ENV{PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR} "${CMAKE_SYSROOT}/usr/lib/${_triple}/pkgconfig:${CMAKE_SYSROOT}/usr/lib/pkgconfig:${CMAKE_SYSROOT}/usr/share/pkgconfig")
